descriptionMarkdown:
Use Item Condition when maintenance, salvage or scarcity matters. Most issued and newly requisitioned equipment 
begins Serviceable. Do not roll condition for every ordinary attack; condition changes when a rule, hazard, critical 
failure, neglect or narrative event specifically threatens the item.
Condition Effect
Pristine
Exceptionally maintained. Ignore the first 
event each mission that would reduce the 
item's Condition.
Serviceable Normal function with no penalty.
Condition Effect
Worn
On a natural 1 during demanding use, the 
item becomes Damaged after resolving the 
action.
Damaged
One property or benefit chosen by the GM is 
unavailable until repaired. A natural 1 during 
demanding use can cause complete failure.
Ruined
The item cannot function until rebuilt or 
replaced with appropriate facilities and 
parts.
A field repair normally improves Damaged to Worn. Proper workshop repair can restore Serviceable. Returning an item 
to Pristine requires exceptional maintenance, master-crafting or replacement components.
